abstract: Between June 1981 and March 1983, data were collected to assess risk factors for gestational trophoblastic disease in a case-control study of 100 women with trophoblastic tumors (17 partial hydatidiform moles, 63 complete moles, and 20 choriocarcinomas) and 200 age-matched controls admitted for normal deliveries to university or general hospitals in Lombardy, Northern Italy. Questions were asked about each patient's general life-style, and medical, obstetric, menstrual, contraceptive, and social history. The risk of trophoblastic disease increased with increasing paternal age: women whose husbands were aged 40-44 years and 45 years or more had a relative risk of 2.4 and 4.2, respectively, compared to women married to men aged under 40 years. This association was independent of maternal age. Cigarette smoking was associated with trophoblastic tumors (relative risk estimate for smokers vs. never smokers = 2.0, 95% confidence interval = 1.2-3.2), the risk being greater for women who smoked more cigarettes and for longer. The effect of cigarette smoking was not explained by any other identified potential distorting factor. A positive history of fertility problems or difficulties in conception and a personal or family history of gestational trophoblastic disease were more common among the cases. Past use of oral contraceptives was not related to the risk of trophoblastic tumors, but use of an intrauterine device was significantly more common among the cases. The findings give epidemiologic support to the evidence of an androgenetic role in the origin of hydatidiform mole; moreover, they provide new hypotheses on the risk factors for gestational trophoblastic disease in developed countries. Further exploration of these factors may lead to a more coherent body of evidence on the etiology of these diseases.
abstract_ja: 1981年6月から1983年3月にかけて、北イタリア・ロンバルディア州の大学病院および一般病院で、絨毛性腫瘍の女性100例（部分胞状奇胎17例、全胞状奇胎63例、絨毛癌20例）と、年齢を合わせた正常分娩の対照200例を対象に症例対照研究を行った。対象者の生活習慣、既往歴、産科歴、月経歴、避妊歴、社会歴について質問を行った。夫の年齢が上がるほど妊娠性絨毛性疾患のリスクが上昇し、夫が40〜44歳では相対危険度2.4、45歳以上では4.2であった。この関連は母親の年齢とは独立していた。喫煙は絨毛性腫瘍と関連し（非喫煙者に対する喫煙者の相対危険度2.0、95%信頼区間1.2〜3.2）、喫煙本数が多いほど、また喫煙期間が長いほどリスクが高かった。喫煙の効果は、同定された他の交絡要因では説明されなかった。症例では不妊や妊娠困難の既往、ならびに個人または家族の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往が多かった。経口避妊薬の過去の使用は絨毛性腫瘍のリスクと関連しなかったが、子宮内避妊具の使用は症例で有意に多かった。これらの所見は、胞状奇胎の起源における雄核発生の役割を支持する疫学的根拠であり、先進国における妊娠性絨毛性疾患のリスク因子について新たな仮説を提示する。これらの因子をさらに検討することで、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病因に関するより一貫した根拠が得られる可能性がある。
